standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that every pro-etale covering of a w-contractible affine scheme is refined by a finite Zariski covering by a disjoint union
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the refinement of each pulled back covering of V_k by a finite disjoint open covering.

core_obligations: Choose a suitable covering (proof lines 6525-6528): take a covering {V_k -> T} of T by affine schemes which are spectra of w-contractible rings, which is a covering in the big pro-etale site.

Refine the pulled back coverings (proof lines 6528-6531): for each k the pro-etale covering obtained by base changing the given covering to V_k is refined by a finite disjoint open covering of V_k, by the refinement property of w-contractible affine schemes.
Conclude (proof lines 6531-6533): the family of all the pieces V_{k,i} is a covering of T in the site which refines the originally given covering {T_i -> T}.
proof_roadmap: Cover the object by w-contractible affine pieces.
Use the refinement property of those pieces to split the induced coverings into finitely many open pieces.
Collect the pieces into a covering of the site refining the original one.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that every pro-etale covering of an object of a big pro-etale site is refined by a covering in the site (statement lines 6515-6523). The proof (proof lines 6525-6534) covers the object by spectra of w-contractible rings, uses the refinement property of those to split the induced coverings into finitely many open pieces, and collects them into the required covering. H2: a three-step refinement with two inputs, written out in full.
